slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the profit to be maximized (i.e., maximize total weekly profit subject to it being at least 3000 yuan), or is the goal simply to find any feasible plan that meets the 3000-yuan profit floor?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total weekly profit, directly covering the missing objective slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or any secondary objective involving unused process capacity, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits it entirely.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize weekly profit; idle time minimization with cost-proportional weights is not part of the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time minimization or a secondary objective, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization and treats process times solely as constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 idle-time minimization objective was never asked about or confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the primary profit-maximization objective and several data/constraint details, but it failed to ask about the secondary idle-time minimization objective and silently omitted it from the final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
